Tim Long

U.S. Taxpayers candidate for U.S. Senate, Michigan · Open seat

Timothy (Tim) Long is the U.S. Taxpayers Party nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan. He is running for the open seat that Democratic Sen. Gary Peters is leaving, and he will be on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where Long stands

Abortion
Says on his Facebook page that he supports the right to life.
Foreign aid and federal debt
Opposes giving U.S. money to other countries while the U.S. is in debt, according to his Facebook page.
Two-party system
Says the two-party system is broken.
